basics.name: Jiyuan Yang
basics.summary: Second-year Ph.D. student in the Department of Statistics, School of Mathematical Sciences, Shanghai Jiao Tong University. Research interests include spatial transcriptomics, high-dimensional omics data analysis, dimension reduction, clustering, simulation, benchmarking, and statistical learning for biomedical data.

work.name: Center for Single-Cell Omics, SJTU School of Medicine
work.summary: Statistical method development and computational analysis for single-cell and spatial omics data.

courses: Co-advisors: Prof. Lin Liu and Prof. Xiaoqi Zheng
